description: Defines the QuicReceivedPacketManager class responsible for managing received packets in QUIC protocol, including tracking, acknowledgment, and packet missing detection.

classes.name: QuicReceivedPacketManager
classes.description: Manages all received packets for a QUIC connection, handling packet reception, acknowledgment frames, missing packet detection, and related state.

methods.name: QuicReceivedPacketManager
methods.description: Default constructor for the packet manager.

methods.name: explicit QuicReceivedPacketManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing with connection stats.

methods.name: SetFromConfig
methods.description: Configures the packet manager based on provided QUIC configuration and perspective.

methods.name: RecordPacketReceived
methods.description: Records the reception of a packet with header, timestamp, and ECN code.

methods.name: IsMissing
methods.description: Checks if a specific packet number is missing.

methods.name: IsAwaitingPacket
methods.description: Checks if the manager is still waiting for a specific packet.

methods.name: GetUpdatedAckFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the current acknowledgment frame, potentially updated.

methods.name: DontWaitForPacketsBefore
methods.description: Deletes missing packets before a specified packet number.

methods.name: MaybeUpdateAckTimeout
methods.description: Updates the acknowledgment timeout based on recent packet reception and RTT.

methods.name: ResetAckStates
methods.description: Resets acknowledgment-related internal states.

methods.name: HasMissingPackets
methods.description: Indicates if there are any missing packets.

methods.name: HasNewMissingPackets
methods.description: Indicates if there are new missing packets to report.

methods.name: peer_least_packet_awaiting_ack
methods.description: Returns the smallest packet number sent by the peer that hasn't been acknowledged.

methods.name: ack_frame_updated
methods.description: Checks if the acknowledgment frame has been updated.

methods.name: GetLargestObserved
methods.description: Returns the largest packet number observed.

methods.name: PeerFirstSendingPacketNumber
methods.description: Returns the first packet number sent by the peer.

methods.name: IsAckFrameEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the acknowledgment frame is empty.

methods.name: set_connection_stats
methods.description: Sets the connection statistics object.

methods.name: ack_frame
methods.description: Returns the current acknowledgment frame.

methods.name: set_max_ack_ranges
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of acknowledgment ranges.

methods.name: set_save_timestamps
methods.description: Configures timestamp saving behavior.

methods.name: min_received_before_ack_decimation
methods.description: Gets the minimum received packets before acknowledgment decimation.

methods.name: set_min_received_before_ack_decimation
methods.description: Sets the minimum received packets before acknowledgment decimation.

methods.name: set_max_retransmittable_packets_before_ack
methods.description: Sets the maximum retransmittable packets before acknowledgment (conditional compilation).

methods.name: set_ack_frequency
methods.description: Sets the acknowledgment frequency.

methods.name: set_local_max_ack_delay
methods.description: Sets the maximum acknowledgment delay.

methods.name: ack_timeout
methods.description: Returns the current acknowledgment timeout.

methods.name: OnAckFrequencyFrame
methods.description: Handles reception of an acknowledgment frequency frame.
